reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Upgrade providers", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: migration-required

consequence.statement: Upgrading to Crossplane v2.0 requires operators to run the "Upgrade providers" step (step 4 of the upgrade approach); the excerpt does not state what breaks if the step is skipped.
consequence.remediation: Follow step 4 "Upgrade providers" in the Crossplane v2.0 upgrade guide (guides/upgrade-to-crossplane-v2).

proposed.statement: Upgrading to Crossplane v2.0 includes a mandatory operator step, step 4 of the upgrade approach, to upgrade providers.
